_note: Copy to config/sources.local.json (gitignored) and edit. It layers on top of the shared catalog in config/sources.json; see merge_sources in pipeline.py for the rules. Only add a board after `pipeline.py discover-ats` has confirmed it -- never guess tokens.

ats_sources.label: Adzuna
ats_sources.note: Needs ADZUNA_APP_ID and ADZUNA_APP_KEY in .env (free at https://developer.adzuna.com/). The only source with a true radius filter, so it reaches small local employers with no modern ATS. Set enabled to true once the keys are in.
